# PST/OST test data

## Committed synthetic fixtures (this directory)

Generated by the test-only writer in `crates/pst/tests/common/mod.rs` (regenerate with
`cargo test -p stv-pst --target-dir target/pst --test synthetic -- --ignored regenerate_committed_fixtures`).
All three contain the same store: Inbox (2 messages: one with a 150 KB XBLOCK attachment, a
text attachment and a two-level embedded message; categories via the named `Keywords`
property), Inbox/Bulk (40 messages), Calendar (2 appointments with start, end, location and
attendees, plus 1 task whose due date is not a contents-table column, so list rows must be
completed from the message), and a hidden Search Root.

| File | Format | Encoding | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `synthetic-ansi-permute.pst` | ANSI (wVer 14) | NDB_CRYPT_PERMUTE | 32-bit ids, 512-byte pages |
| `synthetic-unicode-cyclic.pst` | Unicode (wVer 23) | NDB_CRYPT_CYCLIC | |
| `synthetic-4k-zlib.ost` | Unicode 4K (wVer 36) | none | 4096-byte pages, zlib-compressed blocks |

## Real files (downloaded into `testdata/large/`, git-ignored)

Used by `crates/pst/tests/real_files.rs` (skipped when absent) and the `dump` example.

| File(s) | Source | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Empty.pst` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/outlook-pst-rs/main/crates/pst/examples/Empty.pst (MIT) | empty Unicode PST |
| `example-2013.ost`, `dist-list.pst`, `passworded.pst` | https://github.com/rjohnsondev/java-libpst/tree/develop/src/test/resources | `example-2013.ost` is a real Outlook 2013 **4K-page OST** with zlib-compressed blocks |
| `aspose-MAPI-*.pst/.ost`, `aspose-SMTP-Outlook.pst` | https://github.com/aspose-email/Aspose.Email-for-.NET/tree/master/Examples/Data (MIT) | Unicode PSTs/OSTs with HTML/RTF bodies, attachments, embedded messages, a password-protected PST |
| `aspose-java-*.pst` | https://github.com/aspose-email/Aspose.Email-for-Java/tree/master/Examples/src/main/resources/outlook (MIT) | |
| `enron/albert_meyers/*.pst`, `enron/jeff_dasovich/*.pst`, `enron/sara_shackleton/*.pst` | https://www.ibiblio.org/enron/RevisedEDRMv1_Complete/ (`albert_meyers.zip`, `jeff_dasovich.zip`, `sara_shackleton.zip`; EDRM Enron v1 cleansed, CC BY 3.0) | 35 MB – 616 MB Unicode PSTs, up to 10 000 messages |

No public ANSI (Outlook 97–2002) PST could be found; the ANSI code paths are covered by the
synthetic fixtures and tests.
